kernel.governing_law: The elect bear an invisible mark of piercing light that connects them to a hidden divine network; the fallen cannot perceive this mark, and so the saved remain concealed within the world of matter even as they transcend it.
kernel.mutated_relation: The mark is visible, the piercing fails, the network is exposed — the elect are laid bare and unshielded, their transcendence revoked by its own conspicuousness.

artifacts.enantiomorph:
So none can overlook the exposed congregation… but those of the exposed congregation…⁸⁷


And some others thrust forward for Its spectacle, not of the glare… But still of the glare's spectacle… For it uproots and scatters… It blunts against and endangers… the standing still and alone… and the shallow stage excludes all…


And those not of the glare… they cannot unsee the brand-scar, placed on the forehead of the accused, which has blunted against the transparency of air, and seals out the glare of the shallow stage…


The skin is become a branded animal… But the watchful crowds cannot unsee it…⁸⁸


Uprooting each to the ground below… a blunt iron that blunts against… a brand-scar of liability…

independent.recovered_law: Every relation in Text A is inverted in Text B: preservation becomes exposure, concealment becomes visibility, piercing becomes blunting, anchoring becomes uprooting, letting in becomes sealing out, upward connection becomes downward, saving becomes endangering, and hiddenness from fallen beings becomes inescapable visibility to watchful crowds. The structural law is a systematic reversal of directionality, agency, and epistemic access across all relations.
independent.law_match_note: Both describe the same structural inversion: the elect's hiddenness/protection becomes exposure/visibility, their transcendent connection is revoked, and their shielding is systematically reversed — the recovered claim articulates the full pattern of relational inversions that the declared claim summarizes.
independent.terminal_note: The final lines maintain the full inversion: anchoring upward becomes uprooting downward, piercing sword becomes blunt iron, and the Unicorn Horn of power becomes a brand-scar of liability.
